chunks: As for whatever is in it from Muʿammar ibn Yaḥyā, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAbdullah ibn Jaʿfar al-Ḥimyarī, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd, from Fuḍālah, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Muʿammar ibn Yaḥyā.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the immediate transmitter in the chain
key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: al-Ḥimyarī; a nisbah identifying one of the narrators
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates formal hadith transmission
key_terms.مَعْمَرِ بْنِ يَحْيَى: Muʿammar ibn Yaḥyā; the narrator to whom this transmission route leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain of al-Ṣadūq to Muʿammar ibn Yaḥyā in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage is a sanad/isnad clarification from Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh identifying the author’s transmission route to Muʿammar ibn Yaḥyā. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of authorities through whom the hadith material was transmitted.
